sections.heading: AI Authored PR Metadata (required for Codex/Linear PRs)

prBodyContract.disclosureTemplate: This is an AI-authored contribution, prepared under the [warren](https://github.com/jayminwest/warren) campaign `{campaignId}` (agent `{agent}` on `{provider}/{model}`) and approved by {approvedBy}. Per this repository's PR template, the AI Authored PR Metadata fields are filled below; validation commands and results are reported in the Validation Run section, and any blocked command is declared under Validation Blocked with the exact command and error.
prBodyContract.footerTemplate: Opened by the [warren](https://github.com/jayminwest/warren) campaign controller from a journaled, owner-approved cross-fork intent (campaign `{campaignId}`). The exact request was journaled before any posting; when the campaign policy does not enable the create mutation, this body exists only as dry-run evidence and no pull request is opened.

norms: Produce the smallest possible diff that resolves the issue; main moves at ~100 commits/day, so a scoped same-day fix is the only shape that merges.

Write tests for the happy path plus at least one failure/edge case, and hold diff coverage at or above 80% on changed lines (pnpm test:coverage; pnpm test:rust for Rust changes) — the ci-lite gate refuses PRs below it.
Update docs/TEST-COVERAGE-MATRIX.md for added/removed/renamed feature rows, or state 'N/A: behaviour-only change' honestly; list affected feature IDs under the Related section.
Introduce no new external network dependencies; use the repository's mock-backend policy for anything that would otherwise call out.

Use the pinned toolchain exactly: pnpm 10.10.0 on Node >=24 for the app workspace, Rust 1.96.1 for the core; run pnpm --filter openhuman-app format:check, pnpm typecheck, and the focused tests before finishing.

Never touch vendor/ or app/src-tauri/vendor/ (vendored submodules), never add JS injection to child webviews, never rename RPC namespace strings, and never re-declare vendored contract types — see the repository's AGENTS.md.
Fill the AI Authored PR Metadata section completely and report any blocked command with the exact command and error rather than omitting it; declared uncertainty beats silent omission.
